title: Chinese Chickpea Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired dish made with chickpeas, warming spices, and a hint of Algerian flair.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chickpeas, saffron, soy sauce, and brown sugar (if using) to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the chickpeas are coated in the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the chickpea mixture to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions (optional).
